For independent clinic teams

Your clinic. Your next step.

FluentCare is organised around clinic accounts and individual staff logins. Public app-store downloads are coming soon. Choose the path that fits you.

I’m a clinic owner or manager

Contact us about availability to discuss the current release and evaluation requirements. Review the medical translation app, pricing and privacy before deciding whether to proceed.

Already have an owner account? Open the clinic dashboard to sign in. A link to the dashboard does not confirm that your clinic has been approved or that app downloads are available.

I’m joining my clinic as a staff member

Ask your clinic owner for your invitation and the download instructions for your clinic’s release. Use your own staff account. Your clinic’s translation minutes are shared across the team.

We’ll add direct App Store and Google Play links here when public listings are verified. There is no public download link yet.

Before a release evaluation

Use invented, non-patient details during testing. Healthcare/provider arrangements and clinical language evaluation are still being verified. Do not submit patient information until the applicable requirements are confirmed.

Need help with access or availability? Contact FluentCare.
